g.text: Arc card memory: 603.5 GB/s. this is where the experts live.
host memory: fast enough, and 47.4 GiB of it is already spoken for
NVMe SSD: slower, but there is a lot of it, and it is cheap

svg.text: Normally reading from the SSD into a GPU means: disk to host memory, then host memory to GPU.
Two hops, the CPU involved, and the kernel's storage stack in the middle of it.
There is a way to skip all of that.
